unlisted_practices: Aligning AI implementation with the digital maturity of primary care units
Guiding patients toward digital care channels

screen.reason: Qualitative interview study of healthcare leaders who implemented an AI tool for automated medical history-taking and triage in Swedish primary care; it examines implementation barriers and actions taken but does not quantitatively compare outcomes or test a specific safeguard practice.
